title: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Behaviorally Adequate Test Generation from Software Requirements
abstract: arXiv:2610.36584v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As large language model agents increasingly compile natural-language requirements into repository-level code, requirement-to-test generation grows in importance to provide validation constraints (or harness) to guide code generation. Yet it remains unclear whether current agents can generate tests that validate the required behavior when the implementation of that behavior is withheld. Existing test-generation benchmarks mostly focus on white-box testing, whereas the requirement--test-related study usually requires evaluation on semantic alignment between the given documents and the generated tests.   We introduce Req2Test-Bench, a benchmark containing 5,086 execution-validated instances recovered from developer-authored behavior-driven development (BDD) artifacts in 8 open-source projects, spanning 5 programming languages and 4 BDD frameworks. Each instance pairs a natural-language requirement in Gherkin with its developer-written Tes

translated_title: 面向基于软件需求的行为充分性测试生成的LLM智能体基准评测
translated_abstract: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）智能体日益将自然语言需求转化为仓库级别的代码，“从需求生成测试”变得愈发重要，因为它能够为代码生成提供验证约束（即测试脚手架/harness）。然而，目前尚不清楚现有的智能体能否在对应实现代码被隐藏的情况下，生成能够验证所需行为的测试。现有的测试生成基准大多聚焦于白盒测试，而需求—测试相关的研究通常需要对给定文档与所生成测试之间的语义对齐程度进行评估。我们提出了Req2Test-Bench，这是一个包含5,086个经执行验证实例的基准数据集，这些实例从8个开源项目中开发者编写的行为驱动开发（BDD）工件中恢复而来，涵盖5种编程语言和4个BDD框架。每个实例将Gherkin格式的自然语言需求与开发者编写的测试（配对）……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了Req2Test-Bench基准，包含从8个开源项目BDD工件中恢复的5,086个经执行验证的实例，用于评测LLM智能体在仅依据自然语言需求（无实现代码）的情况下生成行为充分测试的能力。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Req2Test-Bench, a benchmark of 5,086 execution-validated instances recovered from developer-authored BDD artifacts in 8 open-source projects, to evaluate whether LLM agents can generate behaviorally adequate tests from natural-language requirements alone.
